profile.headline: Software Engineer at Finhabits
profile.summary: Product manager specialized in developing and successfully launching SaaS and mobile app products to market. Strategic startup product evangelist responsible for client acquisition, retention, and establishing brand trust. Built strong client relationships which served to provide feedback on product iterations. Analytical thinker who makes feature recommendations based on facts and data.

positions.title: Digital Product Manager
positions.description:
Aquent is a digital, creative, and marketing staffing and recruiting firm.

Project at Citi FinTech
Responsibilities: Defining requirements, developing user stories and leading user story reviews with business, development, design, and governance teams to implement features.

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description:
Applico is a mobile app design and development company.

Responsibilities: Engaged clients on a project basis to define and develop mobile app products and platforms.

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description:
eVestment provides a flexible suite of easy-to-use, cloud-based solutions to help the institutional investing community identify and capitalize on global investment trends, better select and monitor investment managers and more successfully enable asset managers to market their funds worldwide.

Responsibilities: Develop product vision, define product road map, launch products to market, and prioritize feature backlog. Increase client acquisition and client retention. Communicate to sales and marketing new features.

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description: Responsibilities: Gathered client feedback, defined requirements, and developed user stories to implement new features.

positions.title: Client Services, Product Engineer
positions.description:
Former startup specialized in providing a cloud-based risk analytics application and reporting solution to hedge funds, fund-of-funds, endowments, foundations, and family offices. Acquired by eVestment in 2012.

Responsibilities: Performed product demos to prospects, responded to client inquiries via phone and email, implemented and developed clients' fund performance reports, wrote and triaged detailed bug reports, and prioritized feature requests.
